notes.title: Stay home and healthy update
notes.notes:
Hi all,

We would like to encourage the gaming community to stay home and healthy, therefore we decided to push our first update earlier and discount the game for a week. 

As we are going through a weird and hard time, it's important to take care of yourself. If you are in need of a break from working, some exercise or stress relief, why not try a VR game like Drums of War? We promise you, you'll have the necessary exercise while having a lot fun! 

The stay home and healthy update includes licensed track Drunken Dwarves from Wind Rose. Go into bonus mode and enjoy this awesome track brought to you by Napalm Records. Here's the full list of changes: 
Wind Rose "Drunken Dwarves" song added to bonus modes
Adjust height added to pause menu
Tutorial improvements - progress is now blocked until the stick fireball ability is executed
Tutorial improvements - simplified music track when learning movement to reinforce pounding to the beat
Fixed a bug with the Demon Queen's health

We are also preparing another update which includes our new partnership with Indietopia Games and the release of the Drums of War soundtrack from the composer of indie hit 'The Forest: Gabe Castro. If you have something you would like to see (updated) in Drums of War, leave it in the comment section.

Cheers,
Grind Core Games
